{{Quote|Haulers 10 and 67, no racing in the spacelanes&hellip'|[[Controller/Legends|Controller]] [[Geles]]|<ref name="FBS" />}}
'''''Hauler 10''''' was a [[Cargo hauler/Legends|cargo hauler]] owned by the [[Lant Mining Corporation]]. Built to transport refined ores, it was assigned to gather its cargo from the [[Lormar 23]] station in the [[Mangez system/Legends|Mangez system]]. The captain of the ''Hauler 10'' had a tendency for recklessly darting through traffic lanes.
